meaning: ST I q.2 a.3 co., the whole tertia via on the plenitude reading: something is necessary per se, and every necessary being is per se necessary or has its necessity, through a finite chain of necessary causes, from one. Composes tertiaViaSomethingNecessary. 'Quod omnes dicunt Deum' is not used. The Comparator config also verifies withoutNoRegressNoPerSe and withoutNecessaryCauseNoPerSe: each of the two per se premises is needed.
